messages:
lia (pm): quick thread — partner wants to combine trial credits + seat waiver + onboarding burst. need product and legal comfort before we promise.
nate (pricing): stacking promos increases cost tail risk. what's the ask exactly?
priya (sales): Partner D asks: 30-day seat waiver for Starter, 2x onboarding burst credit, and trial credits equal to 1 month usage. They want it visible in invoices and a clause that promo expires automatically.
omar (eng): technical constraints: trial credits are separate ledger; promo stacking is doable but we need deterministic ordering so we don't double-bill tokens. Console visibility for combined balance needs ~1 sprint if automated. Manual layering ok for a short pilot.
harry (finance): quick calc: worst-case marginal cost ~ $9k for 30 days if fully utilized. Need conversion commitments or conversion KPI to mitigate.
jasmin (legal): require explicit abuse & revocation language, and clear notification timeline for promo end (30 days + 7 days notice). No SLA changes.
nate (pricing): propose hard caps and a single-source-of-truth policy:
```
promo_stack_policy = "apply_trial_first, then onboarding_boost, then seat_waiver"
stack_limits = { monthly_token_cap: 200000, onboarding_cap: 80000, duration_days: 30 }
```
lia (pm): proposed launch criteria: signed pilot addendum, billing flag set, CSM runbook, and a cost-alerting metric with daily emails to finance if >60% spend.
priya (sales): partner wants kickoff aligned with their product demo in 3 weeks.
omar (eng): implement options:
- manual: create combined promo record + admin note (ETA 2d)
- automated: update billing service + console (ETA 3 sprints)
harry (finance): manual pilot ok for 1 partner. require pre-flight usage projections and a failover billing plan (charge-back if exceeded).
nate (pricing): if we allow stacking, forbid stacking of multiple onboarding boosts — only one onboarding_boost per account. Also require `promo_uuid` in invoice metadata.
jasmin (legal): will draft clause: promo revocable on suspected abuse, 7-day notice, conversion triggers, marketing collateral permission (if partner requested case study).
lia (pm): decision call: manual pilot with strict guardrails?
priya (sales): +1. Partner is strategic and likely to convert.
omar (eng): ok, will prepare a runbook and a temporary admin field to mark accounts as stacking-enabled. Add monitoring: alert at 50% and 80% of monthly_token_cap.
harry (finance): I'll set up a daily cost report and threshold emails.
nate (pricing): add product rule: if >2 stacking requests in a quarter, prioritize automation and an explicit stack-policy UI.
ops-bot: Jira created: PROMO-STACK-2837777777 assigned to lia (pm).
lia (pm): action items:
- priya: get partner projected token curve + demo dates by Mon (2837777800)
- omar: manual provision runbook + monitoring config (ETA 2d)
- harry: cost threshold + billing fallback statement (ETA 2d)
- jasmin: pilot addendum draft (ETA 3d)
- nate: final `promo_stack_policy` text for invoices (ETA 2d)
lia (pm): any objections?
omar (eng): one ask: include automated throttle fallback if cap breached to protect infra.
nate (pricing): also require CSM attestation before promo lift.
priya (sales): noted. I'll coordinate comms and confirm partner acceptance.
lia (pm): thanks, will post the pilot doc and calendar.
